examples.heading: Combobox focus
examples.description: Focus should be trapped on the Combobox input, but the list of options should not jarringly open on modal open.
examples.code:
import {
  Button,
  Combobox,
  ComboboxInput,
  ComboboxList,
  ComboboxOption,
  Label,
  Modal,
  ModalAction,
  ModalActions,
  ModalBody,
  ModalHeader,
  ModalInset,
  ModalSubtitle,
  ModalTitle,
} from '@vercel/geistcn/components';
import { useState, type JSX } from 'react';

const regions = [
  { value: 'iad1', label: 'Washington, D.C., USA (East) – iad1' },
  { value: 'sfo1', label: 'San Francisco, USA (West) – sfo1' },
  { value: 'lhr1', label: 'London, UK (London) – lhr1' },
  { value: 'fra1', label: 'Frankfurt, Germany (Central EU) – fra1' },
  { value: 'sin1', label: 'Singapore (Southeast Asia) – sin1' },
];

export function Component(): JSX.Element {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [region, setRegion] = useState<string | null>(null);

  return (
    <>
      <Button onClick={() => setOpen(true)} size="small">
        Open Modal
      </Button>

      <Modal active={open} onClickOutside={() => setOpen(false)}>
        <ModalBody>
          <ModalHeader>
            <ModalTitle>Create Database</ModalTitle>
            <ModalSubtitle>
              Choose a region for your database. Reads and writes will take
              place in this region.
            </ModalSubtitle>
          </ModalHeader>

          <ModalInset last>
            <Label value="Region">
              <Combobox
                aria-label="Region"
                onChange={setRegion}
                placeholder="Search regions..."
                size="small"
                value={region}
              >
                <ComboboxInput />
                <ComboboxList>
                  {regions.map((option) => (
                    <ComboboxOption key={option.value} value={option.value}>
                      {option.label}
                    </ComboboxOption>
                  ))}
                </ComboboxList>
              </Combobox>
            </Label>
          </ModalInset>
        </ModalBody>

        <ModalActions>
          <ModalAction onClick={() => setOpen(false)} variant="secondary">
            Cancel
          </ModalAction>

          <ModalAction onClick={() => setOpen(false)}>
            Create Database
          </ModalAction>
        </ModalActions>
      </Modal>
    </>
  );
}
